compute_topk_accuracy: compute the top-k classification accuracy for PyTorch model output and target tensors
create_average_meter: create an AverageMeter instance to track running averages of training metrics like loss or accuracy
update_average_meter: update an AverageMeter with a new value and optional sample count to maintain running statistics
reset_average_meter: reset an AverageMeter to clear all accumulated values and start fresh tracking
use_average_meter_with_window: create an AverageMeter with a sliding window size to track recent metric averages instead of all-time
